ProgramUnit.Name: SET_TOOLBAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_toolbar IS
BEGIN

/*
** this function will be run from initialise windows routine.
** following buttons MUST be enabled all the time.
*/
 set_item_property('toolbar.commit_form', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_block', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_form', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_fld', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.list_values', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.show_keys', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.print_report', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.exit_form', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.display_error', enabled, property_true);

/*
** following buttons can be enabled / disabled
*/
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_record', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.insert', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.delete_record', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.previous_block', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.next_block', enabled, property_false);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK_1.APPL_ID' then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.appl_id',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK_1.GRP_ID' then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.grp_id',action);
 end if;

 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve_info',action);

 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_appl_id_lov',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.list_values', action); 
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve_info',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_appl_id_lov',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.list_values',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
end if;
END;

 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);

 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
